about_body.title: About Thrimana
about_body.body:
Thrimana Advertising & Construction Services (Ruhunu Iron Works) is a trusted name in high-quality iron works, architectural metal fabrication, outdoor advertising solutions, and general construction. With years of experience, precision engineering and creative design, we deliver projects that stand the test of time.

We specialize in:
• Custom iron gates, railings, staircases and structural steel
• LED signage, billboards and branding solutions
• Residential & commercial construction and renovations
• Industrial fabrication and installation

Our commitment is quality craftsmanship, on-time delivery and client satisfaction.
